blog_title: Biowash vs Non-Biowash T-Shirt for Printing — ₹12 Difference, Which Fabric Feels Better?
caption:
Just ₹12 more for biowash — but your prints will feel worlds apart. Non-biowash fabric stays rough; tiny fibers stick up and kill print adhesion. Biowash enzyme treatment smooths it out, reduces pilling after 10 washes, and lets ink sit perfectly flat. Quick test: hold both against your cheek. One feels like canvas, one feels like comfort. For printing businesses, that texture difference = consistent quality per order.

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
